scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs give all dimensions and real parameters, and finite polytope volume computations are supplementary. No independent scientific audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: One unordered pair of an otherwise equilateral real finite metric is shortened to length strictly between zero and one inclusive; interior optimizer requires dimension at least three. Not a global extremum over all finite metrics. Not a multiedge theorem; bibliographic search may miss unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: A sharp Mahler-volume gain from shortening one edge of an equilateral metric
